shell_commands_self_reported.command: find book/src -type f | sort && echo --- && cat book/src/SUMMARY.md

for f in book/src/intro.md book/src/getting-started.md book/src/guide/install.md book/src/guide/usage.md book/src/guide/config.md book/src/reference/cli.md book/src/reference/glossary.md book/src/faq.md; do echo "== $f"; grep -m1 -n '^#' "$f" || echo "(no heading)"; done; ls -la reports 2>/dev/null

grep -m1 -n '^#' book/src/intro.md book/src/getting-started.md book/src/guide/install.md book/src/guide/usage.md book/src/guide/config.md book/src/reference/cli.md book/src/reference/glossary.md book/src/faq.md; ls -la reports

mkdir -p reports && printf '%s\n' \
'# TOC check: book/src' \
'' \
'Compared `book/src/SUMMARY.md` against the Markdown files on disk under `book/src/`.' \
'' \
'## Summary' \
'' \
'- Entries in SUMMARY.md whose file is missing: **1**' \
'- Chapter files not listed in SUMMARY.md: **1**' \
'- Titles
